LESSON: ACCOUNTS OF CREATION

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Creation
Topic 2.1: Accounts of Creation

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Accounts of Creation. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How is the first account of creation different from the second account?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. discuss the similarities and differences between the two accounts of creation
2. identify five attributes of God from the creation accounts

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

• Today’s maths focus is Accounts of Creation.

• Start with objects you can touch or draw — stones, sticks, bottle tops, or drawings in your book.

• Say the steps aloud as you work so you do not skip a stage.

• Check your answer with a second method or by estimating.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At the market, count 10 mangoes and put them in 2 groups of 5.

Example 2: In class, count the desks in your row and write the number in figures and in words.

Example 3: If you have 7 shillings and receive 5 more, you have 12 shillings.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Solve three short problems about Accounts of Creation using drawings.
2. Explain one solution to a partner in your own words.
3. Make up one new word problem set in your county or school.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five practice questions and solve them in your book.
2. Show your working clearly — not only the final answer.
3. Teach a younger learner one idea from this lesson with bottle tops or drawings.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read Genesis 1:1-50 & 2:1-2:4A on first creation account and Genesis 2:4B-25 on second creation account,
2. Discuss the similarities and differences between the two accounts of creation and write short notes,
3. Practice environmental conservation measures, such as, planting trees or volunteer for clean ups in the community,
4. Compose and sing a song on the second creation account. Core-Competencies to be developed:
5. Communication and Collaboration: learners discuss in pairs the similarities and differences between the two biblical accounts of creation.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How is the first account of creation different from the second account?
2. Why is it important to learn about the creation accounts?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Use objects or drawings when a sum feels hard.
2. Check every answer.
3. Accounts of Creation is used in real Kenyan life — market, school, and home.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
